slot.brief: A word is coded by shifting each letter by a fixed number of positions forward/backward; give a new word and ask for its code, easy single-step shift.

stem: If **PLANT** is coded as **RNCPV** in a certain code, then how will **BRAIN** be coded in that code?

verdicts.working: Each letter is shifted forward by 2 positions: P->R, L->N, A->C, N->P, T->V. Applying this +2 shift to BRAIN: B->D, R->T, A->C, I->K, N->P, giving DTCKP.

working:
Each letter is shifted 2 positions forward in the alphabet: P→R, L→N, A→C, N→P, T→V, which gives RNCPV.

Applying the same rule to BRAIN: B→D, R→T, A→C, I→K, N→P, so the code is DTCKP.

Option B has S in place of T, so R was shifted by only 1. Option C shifts B and A by only 1, so it is inconsistent. Option D has J in place of K, so I was shifted by only 1. Only option A follows the +2 rule for all letters.

Independent check: Each letter is shifted forward by 2 positions: P->R, L->N, A->C, N->P, T->V. Applying this +2 shift to BRAIN: B->D, R->T, A->C, I->K, N->P, giving DTCKP.
solution:
Each letter is shifted $+2$ in the alphabet: P→R, L→N, A→C, N→P, T→V, giving RNCPV.

Applying the same rule to BRAIN: B→D, R→T, A→C, I→K, N→P.

$$\text{BRAIN}\to\text{DTCKP}$$

This matches (B).
